$description: Generated theme palette. Like Linear's theme engine, each mode supplies a few key colors and every scale is derived from them in OKLCH (scripts/lib/color.mjs). Key colors are copied verbatim from the web tokens so mobile matches the product's theme. Scales have 12 Radix-style steps: 1 app bg · 2 subtle bg · 3 tinted fill · 4 hover · 5 selected · 6 subtle border · 7 border · 8 strong border · 9 solid (= key) · 10 solid pressed · 11 text · 12 high-contrast text.

light.$description: Lody Light. Source: lody-oss/packages/ui/src/tokens/colors.stylex.ts (lightTheme); merged from --github-merged in components/src/tailwind/index.css.

dark.$description: Vesper, the web's default dark theme. Same sources as light (darkTheme).

algorithm.$description: Shared curves. neutralCurve is the position of each neutral step between background (0) and foreground (1), raised to the mode's contrast exponent; it is fitted so steps 2/3/4/9 land on the web's secondaryBackground / hover / selected / tertiaryLabel in both modes; step 11 sits slightly past secondaryLabel so it keeps 4.5:1 on step 2.

categorical.$description: Label / avatar hues (OKLCH h). Lightness and chroma come from each mode so labels sit in the theme.
